units.title: Eq25: affinity of the actual single-block mixtures
units.reader_note: The explicit affinity bound is shown first; full objects, hypotheses, formula proof and exact Lean are folded below.
units.statement: The actual sign-conditioned Gaussian mixtures have genuinely integrable affinity and satisfy the TV comparison and Eq25.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\in\mathbb N,\ n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), including endpoints and odd dimensions.
\(\mu\) is normalized Haar on full \(O(n)\); \(\nu_b=2\mu|_{\{\det O=b\}}\), \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), and \(P_b=\nu_b\mathrm{bind}[O\mapsto\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})]\).

The source densities are determined Lebesgue-a.e. The chosen \(q_b\) are the actual conditioned-Haar averages of the full Gaussian precision density. Their nonnegativity, measurability, genuine L1, mass one and actual-law identities are obtained internally from the canonical producer.
\(\delta\) is normalized event TV, not the unnormalized variation norm. Affinity L1/range, the TV comparison and B.7 are internal dependencies, never caller hypotheses.

notation.text: All integrals in x use Euclidean Lebesgue volume; the Gaussian exponent uses real n/2. The actual law equality fixes the chosen representative, and a.e. replacement leaves the integrals unchanged.

steps.title: Identify the actual density integrals
steps.text: Reuse the actual mixture-density theorem. For every measurable event, its actual law mass is the integral of the corresponding chosen density. Thus the density event supremum is exactly TV of these same Gaussian mixtures. No arbitrary density or lower-bound witness is supplied.
steps.lean: hd calls MixtureDensities.actual_mixture_densities. hreal, hpos and hneg use withDensity_apply and integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae; hset identifies the exact event-value sets.

steps.title: Apply the single canonical affinity comparison
steps.text: The proved actual density properties instantiate the shared normalized-density theorem. Its square-root L2 argument supplies genuine affinity integrability, the range and Cauchy–Schwarz TV bound. The same compiled node will later provide the lower comparison for actual product densities.
steps.lean: hc calls DensityAffinity.normalized_density_tv_affinity with every condition supplied by hd. htv transports the resulting bound using hset; the general lemma is not an extra premise.

steps.title: Use B.7 for these same actual laws
steps.text: The canonical single-block separation theorem gives a positive lower bound on this very event TV. Square the nonnegative comparison with the Cauchy–Schwarz upper bound. The doubled exponential is exact.
steps.lean: hb7 calls SingleBlockSeparation.single_block_separation; hlow composes its exact ratio chain. hrad, hsquare and hexp justify squaring and compute exp(u)^2=exp(2u); no parity restriction occurs.

steps.title: Take the square root and apply the source log bound
steps.text: Nonnegativity of a gives the first Eq25 inequality. Set t to the explicit positive exponential quarter; n≥3 and κ≥4 imply t<1. The standard log inequality for 1−t>0, together with the sqrt–log identity, gives the second inequality. Mathlib uses the stronger log(x)≤x−1 for every x>0.
steps.lean: hfirst uses Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le. hn0, hs0 and ht1 discharge the domain. hlog calls Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos; hsqrt uses Real.rpow_def_of_pos; hlast applies exp monotonicity and exact rational arithmetic.

steps.title: Consume Eq25 as an actual-affinity power estimate
steps.text: For every natural k, monotonicity of nonnegative powers and exp(k u)=(exp u)^k give the scalar factor needed later by amplification. This is a numerical bound on the actual single-block integral; no equality with a product-law affinity is claimed.
steps.lean: Tests.GaussianComplexitySingleBlockAffinity proves this for all source n,κ and k using single_block_affinity_bound, pow_le_pow_left₀ and Real.exp_nat_mul.

units.lean_statement: Exactly the preproof sealed actual-law signature with only hn and hκ.
units.lean_proof: The exact extracted proof instantiates the shared density node and B.7 internally, then derives the source scalar estimates.
units.boundary: Only actual single-block TV-affinity comparison and Eq25, with genuine affinity L1/range. Existing density/basic-range/B7/Eq24 math is reused without new credit. The focused power consumer is scalar only: no actual independent-block product law, Eq6 coordinate/residual adapter, Tonelli tensorization, amplified TV, transcript/oracle/exact-matvec/query-cap/TV-precision/expected-cost adapters, fixed-spectrum hidden eigenbasis or either main lower bound. No overall completion or purification claim.
